goal: Give NZ a clear Search → Review jobs → Prepare → Apply journey and remove the misleading disabled/busy discovery dead end.
steps: Reproduce source readiness and disabled-button behavior in the deployed account
Add role/location job-board search links that work without employer, CV or source setup and clearly identify external results
Move manual vacancy entry and source administration into optional sections; retain existing country and factual services
Add bounded, non-restarting automatic-import status handling with clear idle/running/completed/partial/failed/interrupted states
Verify browser navigation, error/retry/double-click behavior, native import status, UK isolation and existing tests; rebuild and deploy
scope: Search links are ordinary external board search pages, not scraped/imported vacancy results. Existing direct/Workday imports retain source readiness and explicit campaign selection. No new board scraper or asserted access rights.
data_policy: Search does not fetch boards, call AI, create employers or modify candidate data/configuration. Manual save and advanced campaign edits remain explicit user actions.
rollback: Retain previous image and source artifact; preserve live data volumes.
